Subject: Project Update: Revised Delivery Date of 14 April

I'm writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for the platform took longer to certify than expected, and this has pushed the schedule back by two weeks. The revised delivery date is now 14 April.

We have already adjusted our internal schedule and resourcing to keep the rest of the project on track around this new date, and no other elements of the scope or budget are affected. The certification process is outside our direct control, but we are staying in close contact with the third party to ensure there are no further delays.

Does 14 April still work well with your own plans on your end, or are there any downstream commitments we should be aware of when finalizing the rollout? Please let us know if you'd like to discuss this further, and we'll keep you updated as the integration is finalized.
